costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; unpaid time is substantial — qualifying vulnerabilities take real skill and often many hours to find.

who_qualifies: 18+, US resident, who applies with a social media following; creates a storefront and shares links.
work_available: ZERO GUARANTEED EARNINGS — you earn only when a shopper makes a qualifying purchase through your storefront, links, or shoppable content.

costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; unpaid time is the qualification evaluation.
demand_side: Translation buyers order through Translated.com; you set your rate and wait to be assigned.
what_gets_accepted: A passed qualification evaluation; then assigned projects at your own per-word rate (Translated charges clients ~$0.10/word).
when_cash_arrives: Paid once per month, at the end of the month ('Get paid end of the month, as fast as an employee').
who_pays: Your clients (via Translated.com's marketplace); you set your own per-word rate.
who_qualifies: 18+, bilingual/multilingual, with a computer and good writing skills in both languages; qualification evaluation required before paid work.
work_available: No guaranteed tasks — jobs are assigned per project; earnings depend entirely on the rate you set, your language pair, and whether clients pick you.

demand_side: Requesters post paid HITs on MTurk; per-HIT pay is set by each requester and most small HITs pay pennies.
